subtitle: Claude and Codex usage
desktopOnly: Connect accounts in the macOS app.
rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait before updating.
finishSignIn: Finish signing in in your browser.
signInHelp: Sign in with your Claude subscription.
connectHelp: Connect your account to see usage.
thresholdHelp: Up to 5 values, separated by commas. First: warning; second: high usage.
intervalFailed: Could not save. Select the interval again.
errorLoad: Could not load data. Try again.
errorNotification: Could not send notification. Check macOS permissions.
allowNotifications: Allow KnowYourLimits notifications in macOS Settings.
errorSubscription: Live updates unavailable. Reopen the panel to refresh.
defaultSettingsNotice: Could not read saved settings. Using defaults.
errorStorage: Could not save settings. Check storage access.
errorInterval: Could not save the update interval.
invalidThresholds: Enter 1–5 distinct whole numbers from 1 to 100.
thresholdExample: Enter percentages separated by commas, e.g. 80, 95, 100.
invalidProviders: Choose one or two different accounts.
invalidInterval: Select an update interval from the list.
invalidLanguage: Select a language from the list.
duplicateCounters: Choose different counters, or hide the second one.
installClaude: Install Claude Code, then connect again.
loginClaude: Sign in to Claude Code, then update.
loginCodex: Sign in to Codex, then update.
cacheFailed: Could not restore saved usage. Update to get new data.
updateClaude: Update Claude Code to version 2.1.296, then connect again.
signInTimeout: Sign-in timed out. Try signing in again.
errorCacheSave: Could not save usage for the next launch.
errorPauseSave: Could not save the request pause.
waitRefresh: Wait for the update to finish, or cancel it.
